gloss_en: Tikkun ha-brit — the rectification and guarding of the covenant of sexual holiness (the brit/organ of procreation): repairing pgam ha-brit and maintaining shemirat ha-brit (sexual purity, including tikkun for keri); the general positive tikkun of the brit associated with Yosef — not 'covenant' in the sense of a treaty/pact between parties, nor circumcision as mere ritual act
